patch_description: This version crosses the strongest ideas from the prior programs: short lookback features, rolling and EWM z-scoring for regime invariance, and explicit change-of-character signals such as volatility trend, momentum acceleration, and efficiency trend. It keeps the feature count compact and favors robust, low-depth XGBoost settings to reduce regime-specific overfit while improving prediction spread. I also keep the momentum × volatility interaction, but use multiple normalized variants to help the model preserve slope into the validation regime without relying on long-memory features.
